title: Handling Failure and Accountability
question: Tell me about a time when a project or feature you worked on failed or did not meet expectations. How did you handle it?

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Sets up the project context, expectations, and root cause of failure.

rubric.name: ownership_accountability
rubric.description: Takes direct personal responsibility without shifting blame.

rubric.name: corrective_action
rubric.description: Explains immediate remediation steps and post-mortem actions.

rubric.name: measurable_recovery
rubric.description: Shows how the team recovered or stabilized the system.

rubric.name: learning_growth
rubric.description: Highlights long-term systemic changes or personal learnings applied since.

expected_signals: Implements preventive measures (e.g. tests, monitoring, safeguards)
red_flags: Blames external factors, bad requirements, or colleagues
Downplays severity or pretends failure had no consequence
Fails to articulate any actionable lesson learned
follow_up_prompts: What safeguard or process did you put in place to prevent that failure from happening again?
How did you communicate the failure and recovery to stakeholders?
